settings.name: DARSHIT PLAYZ
settings.intro: Creative video editor specializing in gaming edits, short-form content, cinematic edits, and engaging social media videos.
settings.aboutText: I'm Darshit, a video editor who turns raw gameplay and footage into content people actually want to watch. My work sits at the intersection of pacing, sound design, and motion — fast-cut gaming highlights, scroll-stopping shorts, and cinematic edits that feel intentional from the first frame. I work with streamers, gaming creators, and small brands who want their footage to feel bigger than it is, and I care about hitting deadlines as much as hitting the beat.

projects.title: Clutch Ranked Highlights — Ep. 4
projects.description: Fast-paced highlight reel cut to match round-ending clutches, with impact sound design and quick zoom punches on every kill.

projects.title: 3 Second Hook — Reel Cut
projects.description: Vertical short built around a three-second hook, jump cuts on beat, and bold captions for silent autoplay viewing.

projects.title: Golden Hour — Cinematic Travel Cut
projects.description: Slow, mood-driven edit with a warm grade and match cuts timed to an ambient score.

projects.title: Channel Intro — Logo Reveal
projects.description: 5-second animated logo reveal with kinetic type, built for a gaming channel's intro bumper.

projects.title: Full Episode Edit — Let's Play Ep. 12
projects.description: Long-form let's-play edit trimmed from 90 minutes to a tight 18, with chapter markers and pacing notes for the creator.

projects.title: Season Recap — Best Moments
projects.description: End-of-season montage stitched from a full year of clips, synced to a rising track for a highlight-reel finish.
